body.purpose: General content, log entries, supporting text.

label.purpose: Button text, form labels, section headers inside modals.

data.purpose: Grid cell strain codes, badge text, dense status indicators. Fixed at small sizes — never scales.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default for all state transitions: button press, hover, tab switch, color change.

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Bottom-sheet modal entrance. The only positional animation in the system.

motion.name: press-card
motion.purpose: Physical press feedback on card-buttons and list rows. Applied via .press-card CSS class.

motion.name: reduced-motion-fallback
motion.purpose: Applied under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). The modal appears instantly; press-card is opacity-only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width, 44px minimum height. Signal Blue fill. Used for all primary confirmations in modals and action sheets.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0a84ff; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2892ff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0a6fd6; transform: scale(0.985); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.40; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a84ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button with separator border. Used for Cancel, Clear, and non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.90); transform: scale(0.985); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.30); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button (active state)
components.description: Alert Red border and text on active/confirm tap only. Never the default visual state of a button.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: transparent; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { border-color: rgba(255,69,58,0.30); color: #ff453a; transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,69,58,0.30); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface-1 background, separator border. Used for all text fields and search inputs across the tool.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1c1c1e; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 44px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(235,235,245,0.30); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.40; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: 3-option room/sub-tab switcher. Signal Blue fill on active. Used at the top of Grow Rooms tab.
components.css: .ds-seg-wrap { display: flex; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px; } .ds-seg-item { flex: 1; background: transparent; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.60); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 32px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a84ff; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-seg-active { background: #0a84ff; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base content container. Graphite Surface (#1c1c1e), 16px radius, separator border. Used for mother entries, stat boxes, list groups.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1c1c1e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); } .ds-card-sub { font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.60); }

components.name: Square Cell — Planted
components.description: Grow-room grid cell with strain assigned. Signal Blue tint, 8px radius, strain code + pot dot + plant count. Tester badge appears on perimeter cells.
components.css: .ds-square-planted { aspect-ratio: 1/1; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.30); background: rgba(10,132,255,0.10); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 2px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: background 150ms ease-out; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-square-planted:active { background: rgba(10,132,255,0.20); } .ds-sq-code { font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0a84ff; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 100%; padding: 0 2px; } .ds-sq-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-pot-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pot-green { background: #30d158; } .ds-pot-black { background: #636366; } .ds-sq-count { font-size: 8px; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.40); line-height: 1; } .ds-tester { position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 2px; font-size: 7px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffd60a; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Square Cell — Empty Perimeter
components.description: Unplanted cell on the outer edge of a bed. Amber dashed border signals tester-plant eligibility.
components.css: .ds-square-perimeter { aspect-ratio: 1/1; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px dashed rgba(255,214,10,0.25); background: rgba(255,214,10,0.04); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-square-perimeter:active { background: rgba(255,214,10,0.10); } .ds-sq-plus { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.25); line-height: 1; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Rounded pill for health states (Active, Sidelined, Done) and strain category markers. Three semantic variants.
components.html: ActiveSidelinedPoor
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-green { background: rgba(48,209,88,0.15); color: #30d158; border-color: rgba(48,209,88,0.40); } .ds-badge-yellow { background: rgba(255,214,10,0.15); color: #ffd60a; border-color: rgba(255,214,10,0.40); } .ds-badge-red { background: rgba(255,69,58,0.15); color: #ff453a; border-color: rgba(255,69,58,0.40); } .ds-badge-blue { background: rgba(10,132,255,0.15); color: #0a84ff; border-color: rgba(10,132,255,0.40); } .ds-badge-purple { background: rgba(191,90,242,0.15); color: #bf5af2; border-color: rgba(191,90,242,0.40); }

components.name: Health Dots
components.description: Five 4px dots. Filled to the health level in the level's semantic color. Unfilled dots at white/15.
components.css: .ds-health-dots { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; } .ds-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-dot-on { background: #30d158; } .ds-dot-off { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

narrative.overview:
Mother Log is built like a field instrument — not a screen you admire, but a tool you grip. Somewhere between a weather station display and a grow-room clipboard, it reads at a glance, responds without ceremony, and gets out of the way the moment you have what you need. The design premise is a person with soil on their gloves reading this on a phone in a dark room at 6am. Every decision answers to that premise.

The visual language is iOS dark-native, not dark-mode: surfaces are built from black up (#000 → #1c1c1e → #2c2c2e) rather than inverted from a light system. Depth is tonal, not shadow-based. Semantic color carries all health, status, and alert meaning — Signal Blue for primary actions, Vitality Green for good health, Caution Amber for watch states, Alert Red for poor or destructive. Color is not decoration here; it is data.

Typography is a single system-native stack (SF Pro / system-ui). No display typefaces, no pairing. The hierarchy is communicated through weight and size alone — bold data labels at 10–11px in grid cells, semibold 14–16px for primary text, regular muted text for supporting context. Density is a feature, not a compromise.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic color as data, not as decoration
Bottom-sheet modal pattern throughout (never centered dialogs)
Information density appropriate to a field tool — not sparse, not cluttered

rules.name: The One Role Rule
rules.body: Each semantic color maps to exactly one meaning system-wide. Signal Blue = primary action. Vitality Green = good health / green pots. Never use Vitality Green to mean 'confirmed' or Signal Blue to mean 'healthy.' If a new screen breaks the mapping, rethink the screen, not the mapping.

rules.name: The Alpha Protocol
rules.body: Semantic colors appear in three forms only: color/15 for backgrounds, color/40 for borders, color solid for text and icons. Do not invent intermediate opacities. The three-stop system keeps all health-coded surfaces immediately recognizable.

rules.name: The No-Clamp Rule
rules.body: All type sizes are fixed px values, never fluid clamp(). The app targets mobile at a consistent DPI; fluid headings solve a problem this tool doesn't have and add visual instability.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Maximum weight is 700 (font-bold). font-black (900) is never used. The design is dense enough — weight beyond 700 competes with semantic color for attention.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are prohibited. If a container needs to read as 'above' another, step up the surface token. If there is no surface token at the right level, the hierarchy is wrong — rethink it.

rules.name: The Glass Exception
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur(20px) on the header bar only. Glass effects are never used for content containers, modals, or cards. The single use case is the fixed header sitting above scrollable content.

dos: Do keep all touch targets ≥ 44px height. Test on actual device, not browser DevTools.
Do use the three-stop alpha protocol for semantic colors: /15 background, /40 border, solid text.
Do open contextual detail in a bottom-sheet modal. Always. Not a new page, not a centered dialog.
Do use tonal surface stepping for depth (#000 → #1c1c1e → #2c2c2e). If a new surface level is needed, it doesn't exist — rethink the layout.
Do keep the tab bar at the bottom and respect safe-area insets on all screens.
Do use press-card (scale 0.985, opacity 0.85) on card-buttons and list rows so tap feedback is immediate.
Do add prefers-reduced-motion alternatives to every CSS animation.
donts: Don't use drop shadows on any surface. Not box-shadow, not filter: drop-shadow.
Don't use Signal Blue (#0a84ff) as a category color, decoration, or highlight. It means 'primary action' and nothing else.
Don't design this like a SaaS dashboard (Notion, Linear, startup blue-on-white). No sidebar navigation, no card-grid scaffolding, no hero metrics.
Don't design this like a dispensary POS or retail inventory app. No product tiles, price displays, or customer-facing shopping patterns.
Don't use colored border-left or border-right stripes greater than 1px as card accents.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Single solid semantic color only.
Don't use glassmorphism on content containers. Glass is reserved for the fixed header bar only.
Don't use font-black (weight 900). Hard cap at font-bold (700).
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrows to every section heading. One deliberate muted label per layout zone maximum.
Don't invent a new semantic color for a new feature. Map to the existing vocabulary or make the feature fit the vocabulary.
